item.title: Karnataka deploys AI cameras and thermal drones to curb rising human–wildlife conflict
item.description: The Karnataka Forest Department is rolling out AI-enabled cameras and thermal drones to generate real-time alerts as part of a new strategy to address the growing human–wildlife conflict across the State. item.title: 24 Meghalaya girls rescued from unsafe Karnataka hostel amid ongoing custody case
item.description: The Karnataka government safely repatriated 24 girl-children from Meghalaya after rescuing them from an unlicensed hostel in Chikkaballapur, but the move has triggered unexpected anger from several parents, who claimed their daughters were studying well and had no complaints. item.title: CCTV video of child hit by speeding bike sparks calls for stricter road safety near schools
item.description: A disturbing CCTV clip from Patiala, Punjab, has gone viral, showing the moment a 7-year-old child was struck by a speeding motorbike shortly after stepping off a school bus. The video, widely shared across social media, has triggered renewed demands for stronger road safety measures near school bus stops. item.description: A wedding celebration in Bodh Gaya, Bihar, descended into chaos after an argument over a shortage of rasgullas erupted into a violent clash between the bride’s and groom’s families. item.description: A bizarre trend centred on the phrase “19-minute viral video” has taken over Indian social media, revealing how quickly AI-generated misinformation can spread and how easily online speculation can damage real people’s reputations. item.title: Hardik Pandya shines with disciplined spell in SMAT, boosts confidence ahead of South Africa T20Is
item.description: Star all-rounder Hardik Pandya continued his strong run in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT), delivering a tight four-over spell for Baroda against Gujarat in Hyderabad on Thursday.
